question: What sectional counts distinguish the Vaiṣṇavī and Śāṅkarī forms in this context?
premises: The Vaiṣṇavī form is said to have seven sections.
The Śāṅkarī form is said to have five sections.
inference: In this context Vaiṣṇavī and Śāṅkarī are differentiated by seven and five sections respectively.
plain_english: The Vaiṣṇavī may be of seven sections, but the Śāṅkarī of five sections.
